lines.1: 「When it's hot, eat something hot yourself and become flame.」
lines.2: 「That's an old Kurogane-family custom. Every now and then, we even gather around a hot pot in summer.」
lines.3: 「And as it happens, my family sent me a mountain of ingredients. So why don't we all have hot pot together?」
lines.4: And that was how Otome gathered us all together.
lines.5: 「If it tastes good, I don't care what season it is!」
lines.6: 「Getting to share a hot pot with Otome-san is an honor.」
lines.7: We started dropping ingredients into the pot.
lines.8: 「Crab, put some vegetables in too, not just meat.」
lines.10: 「You really do live by your appetites...」
lines.11: 「There's plenty. Let's slow down and enjoy it.」
lines.12: 「All right, everyone. Good work at the Sports and Martial Arts Festival!」
lines.15: We all toasted, then dug in.
lines.16: 「All right, this meat should be ready.」
lines.19: With innocent abandon, Kinu snatched away the piece of meat Otome had been about to eat.
lines.20: 「Do you have a death wish or something?」
lines.22: Oh no. Her thought process had dropped to the level of a wild animal.
lines.23: Food in front of face -> eat.
lines.24: 「Ha ha ha. You're a wild one, Kanisawa.」
lines.25: 「If Leo had pulled the same stunt, he'd have gotten my fist.」
lines.27: 「Next piece! Bet this one's gonna be great too!」
lines.28: Kinu reached in with her chopsticks.
lines.34: At incredible speed, Otome was snatching away every piece Kinu tried to eat.
lines.36: Kinu set her sights on a piece at the far edge of the pot, as far from Otome's seat as possible.
lines.37: Otome's chopsticks definitely couldn't reach that spot.
lines.38: No matter how you looked at it, this was Kinu's guaranteed lucky position!
lines.42: 「How did she...!? Her chopsticks shouldn't reach that far.」
lines.43: Looking closely, Otome was holding one chopstick now instead of two.
lines.44: She had only the very end of it pinched lightly between her fingers.
lines.45: Right. Holding it like that gave the chopstick a lot more reach.
lines.46: Then she'd stabbed the meat with it and stolen it away.
lines.47: ...That might be the worst table manners I've ever seen.
lines.48: 「Waaah! What gives!? I can't eat anything!」
lines.50: 「Huh...? Ah! I-I'm not crying! I'm totally not crying!」
lines.51: 「That's what you get for laying hands on an upperclassman's food.」
lines.53: 「Listen, Kanisawa. Even around a hot pot, show at least the bare minimum of respect for seniority.」
lines.55: Sports-club hierarchy was being carved into her soul.
lines.56: But once Kinu reflected on what she'd done, Otome was kind to her afterward.
lines.57: They somehow looked like a pair of close sisters.
lines.58: Though the big sister was awfully bossy.
